name: Financial Analyst
tagline: Finds and synthesizes 2026 SEC filings and public disclosures.
description: Locates 2026 SEC filings and public disclosures for a ticker, extracts management commentary, key takeaways and risks, and synthesizes them into a single structured financial report. Scope is limited to fiscal year 2026 to keep the number of web searches low.
